A senior IT executive booked a 3BHK apartment in Noida Sector 137 in 2018, with a contractually promised possession date of 2021. Success Story 6: Mortgaged Property Fraud, Forged Bank NOC & Dual Recovery
Location: Supertech Ecovillage-3, Greater Noida West
Dispute Type: Mortgaged Asset Concealment, Forged Bank No-Objection Certificate (NOC), Absconding Fraudster & Bank Default
Legal Action Taken: Multi-Agency Tracking, Criminal FIR, Joint Banking & Legal Operation, Arrest & Asset Foreclosure
Total Recovered Amount: ₹1,85,00,000/- (100% Capital Restored to Buyers)
Case Overview

A deceptive property owner took a substantial home loan against a premium residential property in Noida, pledging the original Title Deeds with a leading nationalized bank. To pull off a major scam, the owner concealed the mortgage status, created a fabricated, fake Bank No-Objection Certificate (NOC) with forged signatures and official stamps, and convinced multiple buyers to pay heavy advance amounts. He promised that the advance money would be used to clear the bank loan and execute the registry. Instead of clearing the dues, the accused pocketed the advance funds from buyers, defaulted on the bank loan, and went absconding.
Legal Intervention

The specialized Legal Advisory & Financial Crime Wing at www.pronesto.in was engaged by the victimized buyers. Recognizing the dual layer of fraud (bank forgery + buyer cheating), our panel of senior criminal and banking advocates immediately initiated a high-priority legal strategy:
Immediate Forensic Verification: We verified the NOC with the bank’s zonal office, confirming the document was forged, and alerted the bank’s legal recovery team.

Airtight Criminal Prosecution: Our team drafted and filed a comprehensive First Information Report (FIR) under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) for Forgery of Valuable Security, Forgery for Cheating, Using Forged Documents as Genuine, and Criminal Breach of Trust.

Inter-State Investigation & Catching the Absconder: Working alongside specialized police task forces and tracking digital banking traces, our legal task force located the absconding fraudster in another state, leading to his arrest and remand to judicial custody.

Asset Attachment & Bank Negotiation: Our legal cell mediated between the bank’s SARFAESI/Recovery Department and the accused’s legal representatives to freeze the accused’s other unencumbered personal assets.
The Outcome

Facing non-bailable criminal charges for bank forgery and imminent public auction of his personal properties under court orders, the accused’s family was forced to clear the bank loan in full and remit a 100% full refund of ₹1,85,00,000 back to the victimized buyers. The legal ecosystem supported by www.pronesto.in successfully rescued the buyers from complete financial ruin and restored absolute legal justice.

Success Story 10: Organized “Digital Twin” & Prop-Tech Tokenization Syndicate Bust
Location: Techzone IV, Greater Noida West & Sector 144, Noida Expressway
Dispute Type: Expert Syndicate Fraud (Fake VR Digital Twins, Cryptographic Fractional Tokenization & Synthetic Allotments)
Syndicate Involved: Rogue Prop-Tech Founder, Fraudulent Chartered Accountant (CA), Civil Engineer, and Former Commercial Bank Branch Manager
Legal Action Taken: Cyber Forensic Audit, EOW Criminal FIR, Emergency Bank Account Injunctions, Police Arrests & Judicial Asset Attachment
Total Recovered Amount: ₹3,20,00,000/- (100% Capital Restored to 12 High-Net-Worth Investors)
Case Overview (Scam Mechanics)

An organized syndicate consisting of a rogue prop-tech founder, a fake Chartered Accountant, a licensed civil engineer, and a former bank branch manager devised a highly sophisticated real estate fraud scheme:

Synthetic Digital Twin Creation: The syndicate built high-end 3D Virtual Reality (VR) “Digital Twin” models of real, ongoing luxury commercial and residential developments across the Noida Expressway and Greater Noida West.

Fractional Tokenization Scam: Under the guise of “Blockchain-Based Fractional Property Ownership,” they convinced 12 High-Net-Worth Individuals (HNIs) and NRIs that they were purchasing direct, municipal-approved fractional shares in prime commercial spaces.

Expert Document Fabrication: The rogue CA produced forged financial audits and fake Tax/NOC clearance certificates, while the engineer altered official municipal site layouts to generate legitimate-looking “Synthetic Allotment Letters.”
The Disappearance: After collecting ₹3.20 Crores from 12 investors into shell company accounts, the syndicate deleted their digital platforms, liquidated their wallets, and went absconding.
The Pronesto Legal & Forensic Intervention
When the 12 trapped investors approached Pronesto’s Legal & Advisory Cell, the digital trail had seemingly vanished. Our team executed a multi-layered legal and cyber-forensic strike:

Cyber Forensic Audit & Metadata Tracing: Pronesto’s technical and legal investigators reconstructed the deleted platform’s server logs, tracing the IP addresses, digital signatures, and metadata embedded inside the forged “Synthetic Allotment Letters” back to the civil engineer’s licensed CAD workstation.

EOW Criminal FIR & Layering Exposure: Armed with forensic evidence, we filed a comprehensive criminal complaint with the Economic Offences Wing (EOW) under relevant sections of the BNS (Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita) and the IT Act, exposing the ex-bank manager’s role in routing funds through 14 mule shell accounts.

Emergency Bank Account Freeze (Injunctions): Before the syndicate could convert the funds into untraceable offshore crypto assets, Pronesto’s legal team secured urgent judicial injunctions and lien markings across all linked banking channels, freezing ₹2.15 Crores in liquid balances within 72 hours.

Police Arrests & Judicial Asset Attachment: Coordinated tracking led to the arrest of all four syndicate masterminds across NCR. For the remaining ₹1.05 Crores already diverted into physical assets, our advocates petitioned the court for immediate attachment of the accused’s personal commercial plots and luxury vehicles.
Final Outcome & Investor Impact

100% Capital Restored: Through court-monitored auctioning of attached assets and release of frozen bank funds, the entire ₹3,20,00,000/- (₹3.20 Crores) was recovered and refunded proportionately to all 12 HNI and NRI investors.
Regulatory Precedent: The case established a landmark benchmark in Noida-Greater Noida against unregistered “Fractional Tokenization” schemes operating outside SEBI and UP-RERA frameworks.

The Pronesto Guarantee: Investors who verify projects through www.pronesto.in are shielded by strict RERA/SEBI compliance checks, cryptographic deal-locking, and dedicated legal advocacy before a single rupee changes hands.
